The article *Explainable AI for Microseismic Event Detection*, led by SEEM PhD student Ayrat Abdullin with Dr. Denis Anikiev and Dr. Umair bin Waheed, is available in *Artificial Intelligence in Geosciences* [@abdullin2026xai].

The study applies Grad-CAM and SHAP to examine the waveform evidence behind PhaseNet decisions. It also introduces a SHAP-gated inference scheme designed to improve detection reliability and robustness under strong noise.

To support transparent and reproducible research, the authors released the implementation, experiments, and supporting scripts through the SEEM-KFUPM GitHub organization and archived version 1.0 on Zenodo.
